subject.title: docs: document embedded compaction context contracts

question: Should maintainers recreate the focused comment slice from this PR on current main and use it as the canonical embedded-runner comment pass over the overlapping documentation PRs?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label, overlap with other stale comment PRs, and author comment asking to prefer this fuller pass require maintainer choice rather than an automated cleanup close.

options.title: Recreate focused slice
options.body: Apply only the useful comments from this PR onto current main, run whitespace/focused checks, and close the overlapping stale comment PR as superseded afterward.

options.title: Consolidate broader pass
options.body: Combine this PR with the overlapping embedded-runner comment PRs before landing if maintainers want a wider documentation sweep.

options.title: Pause comment sweep
options.body: Leave the PR open or close manually if maintainers decide broad source contract comments are not wanted right now.

recommendation.title: Recreate focused slice
recommendation.body: Apply only the useful comments from this PR onto current main, run whitespace/focused checks, and close the overlapping stale comment PR as superseded afterward.
